main_text.head: DE ANNONAE CARITATE CONCIO II.
CAVSAE ENVMERANTVR, quibus inductus Deus, bonos pariter ac malos caritate & fame puniat.
main_text.p: IN omnibus publicis calamitatibus quibus genus humanum subiectum, duo praecipuè consideranda veniunt, à quo & quam ob causam haec mala generi humano accidat. De his autem corruptum est mundi iudicium, causas secundas potius quàm primam & motricem causam respicit vulgus hominum, hinc fit, vt nec quid consilij capiant, nec quomodo se se gerere debeant, satillis constet. Ex his autem publicis calamitatibus peste, fame, bello, non vltima est annonae caritas & fames, de qua nobis instituta est oratio. Et proxima quidem Concione, tantae calamitatis & egestatis, veram ac primam causam, authorem & effectorem Deum esse sacrarum literarum testimonijs & exemplis probavimus.

page.notes: Initial "I" is a decorated woodcut letter, read as I with [?] for the first letter of "IN". Long s rendered as s throughout. Spelling u/v and i/j normalised as instructed. The word after "satillis" is read as "satis illis" with the printed form "fatillis"; uncertain: "fat illis" printed, read as "sat illis" [?]. Header text "DE ANNONAE CARITATE" is part of the heading, not a running head, since it sits as a division title on a page opening a concio.
